description_en: Retrieves the information of a specified category and the list of its subcategories (immediate child categories)
description_zh: 获取指定的分类信息，及其子分类（即下一级分类）的列表
name: GetAssetCategory

parameters.help_en:
The category ID. You can obtain the category ID by using the following methods:

When you create a category by calling the CreateAssetCategory operation, the category ID is the value of CategoryId in the response.

When you query the category list by calling the ListAssetCategories operation, the category ID is the value of CategoryId in the corresponding entry in the response
parameters.help_zh:
分类ID。可通过以下方式获取：

通过CreateAssetCategory接口创建分类时，分类 ID 为返回参数 CategoryId 的值。

通过ListAssetCategories查询分类列表时，分类 ID为请求后返回的对应条目 CategoryId 的值
parameters.name: category_id
